name: two_wheeler_pd
trained_on: L&T Vehicle Loan Default, train.csv, DEV split only (seed 20261001, dev fraction 0.3); the test split was not read

blend.selection: smallest weight within 0.002 of the best dev AUC

use: Risk Scoring agent, TWO_WHEELER product only: overall = rule score + weight * scale * (logit(p) - logit(base_rate)), then FinSight's knock-out rules
limits: Indian two-wheeler loans from one lender (L&T, ~2018); other products are unchanged
no income or tenure in the training data — those still come only from the rule engine
probability is relative risk, not a calibrated PD for a different portfolio
